title: 5 things advertisers need to know about FAST channels

facts.fact: Roku's 2026 VOD Evolution Canada study found that 44% of streamers find looking for something new to watch 'stressful'.
facts.quote: 44% of streamers told us they find it “stressful” looking for something new to watch

facts.fact: Roku's 2026 VOD Evolution survey of Canadian streamers included more than 2,000 respondents.
facts.quote: In our 2026 VOD Evolution survey among more than 2,000 Canadians

facts.fact: Roku's 2026 VOD Evolution survey found that 56% of Canadian streamers stream linear content, which includes broadcast channels as well as FAST channels.
Roku's 2026 VOD Evolution survey found that Canadian streamers spend on average 4 hours and 12 minutes per week watching free streaming with ads, an hour more than the previous year.
facts.quote: on average, Canadian streamers are spending 4 hours and 12 minutes a week watching free streaming with ads

facts.fact: Roku offers more than 200 FAST channels, including French-language channels.
facts.quote: Roku offers more than 200 FAST channels, including French language channels

facts.fact: FAST channels are free for viewers.
facts.quote: Oh, and FAST channels are free.

facts.fact: According to Roku, FAST is always free, whereas AVOD often is free but not all of the time.
facts.quote: while FAST is always free, AVOD often is, but not all of the time.

facts.fact: FAST channels have scheduled programming accessible through a guide and regular ad breaks, delivered through streaming platforms.
facts.quote: they have scheduled programming that’s accessible through a guide as well as regular ad breaks, only they’re delivered through streaming platforms

facts.fact: According to a fall 2025 Media Technology Monitor study, 41% of online Canadians watch FAST channels.
facts.quote: with 41% of online Canadians now watching FAST channels.

facts.fact: According to a fall 2025 Media Technology Monitor study, FAST channel viewing among online Canadians nearly doubled in the year before.
facts.quote: FAST channel viewing among online Canadians nearly doubled in the year before

facts.fact: According to Media Technology Monitor, the most popular FAST channel in Canada is Roku Channel, followed by Tubi and Pluto TV.
facts.quote: the most popular FAST channel in Canada is Roku Channel, followed by Tubi and Pluto TV

facts.fact: According to Media Technology Monitor, FAST channel viewers skew older than on other platforms and tend to come from more affluent households.
facts.quote: FAST channel viewers skew older than on other platforms

facts.fact: According to Gracenote research, less than 14% of content on FAST channels was made before 1990.
facts.quote: less than 14% of content on FAST channels was made before 1990

facts.fact: According to Gracenote research, nearly half (45%) of the video content on FAST channels was produced after 2019.
facts.quote: nearly half (45%) of the video content on FAST channels was produced after 2019

facts.fact: According to Gracenote, the five global SVOD platforms (Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV+, Disney+, Netflix and Paramount+) now show more pre-1990 programming than FAST channels do.
facts.quote: the five global SVOD platforms (Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV+, Disney+, Netflix and Paramount+) now show more pre-1990 programming than FAST channels do

facts.fact: According to a late 2025 Media in Canada report, Tubi and CBC will expand their FAST portfolios.
facts.quote: Tubi will be expanding its FAST portfolio, as will CBC
